node.title: Re: perlcritic and heredocs
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I agree with [Corion] that you'll need to show the code that produces these issues - I haven't been able to reproduce ProhibitMismatchedOperators at all yet, I've only been able to reproduce ProhibitHardTabs inside q{}'s, not heredocs, and [mod://Perl::Critic::Policy::ValuesAndExpressions::ProhibitImplicitNewlines|ProhibitImplicitNewlines] explicitly states to use heredocs instead of multiline quoted strings.

In other words, this produces ProhibitHardTabs and ProhibitImplicitNewlines policy warnings:

my $foo = q{ if ($a == 'bar') { } SELECT foo FROM bar WHERE quz==3; };

while this doesn't:

my $foo = <<'END'; if ($a == 'bar') { } SELECT foo FROM bar WHERE quz==3; END

Are you sure you're not using multi-line quoted strings instead of heredocs...?
